Sophisticated and fresh, minimal with just enough Chinese jade-craft personality. NOT circular, not an oval seal, not a long capsule or generic rounded rectangle. Keep it thin and simple.

stageOptions.name: A · 小城楼
stageOptions.prompt: Use case: game UI button concept, ONE standalone STAGE SELECTION button only, isolated on genuinely transparent alpha background. For 桃园小英雄, a bright hand-painted 2D Chinese Three Kingdoms chibi mobile game with chunky warm brown outlines, cheerful cel shading, sage jade greens, honey ochre and restrained vermilion. This must visually communicate a GAME LEVEL / CHINESE FORTIFIED PASS ENTRANCE, not be a generic arrow plaque. Intended display around96x88 game pixels, simple recognizable large shapes. Button illustration occupies roughly60% canvas width and stays compact. Tiny, charming, collectible game-map destination icon with shallow illustrated depth, frontal/slightly elevated view, not realistic 3D architecture. No entire game screen, background, scenery board, landscape rectangle, hero, UI panel, device frame, comparison labels, diagrams or annotations. No arrows/chevrons. Keep decoration highly restrained, no glow, no complex carved details, no giant shadow. At base an integrated small cream/jade readable label containing ONLY these two exact Chinese characters: '关卡'. No other writing anywhere. The entire silhouette should work as a small clickable secondary UI control. A cute compact miniature Chinese fortified city gate as the button itself: a single broad arched opening in warm pale sand-colored wall, two chunky side piers, a simple shallow curved moss-jade tiled roof over the top with dark brown organic outline and gold ridge cap. Warm vermilion double doors slightly OPEN in the arch, glowing warm ivory daylight visible through the gap (subtle, no bloom). One tiny plain red pennant at the roof corner, NO writing on pennant. Narrow green foundation/plaque just under arch carries ivory '关卡'. Friendly broad architecture, almost toy-like, uncluttered readable at small scale. Not a round medallion or rectangle with a picture on it: actual irregular castle-gate silhouette.
